notable_quotes: Hydrogen bonding helps organize the framework, including an N3-H3···O2 contact of 2.8427(15) Å with a 175° angle.
The compound is identified as poly[(µ3-hydrogenphosphato)(4H-1,2,4-triazole-κN1)zinc], indicating a polymeric zinc hydrogenphosphate-triazole framework.
A second strong hydrogen bond, O4-H4···O1, measures 2.5978(12) Å with a 164° angle, supporting supramolecular connectivity.
